approach: Greedy comparison between 2-pack cost per unit and 4-pack cost per unit.
observation: If Y >= 2*X, buying two 2-packs is cheaper or equal to a 4-pack, so buy ceil(Z/2) two-packs. If Y < 2*X, buy as many 4-packs (Z/4) as possible and greedily resolve remainder cans.
bruteForce: Try all possible numbers of 2-packs and 4-packs. O(Z) time complexity.
optimalSolution: Math / Greedy integer division. O(1) per testcase.
